subject: Immediate visibility request — queue overflow causing 5xx spikes & SLA exposure
messages:
From: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@clearpoint.com>
To: Grace OConnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearpointbank.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Spike in 5xx + token queueing — urgent

Grace —

We started seeing sustained 5xx errors and token queueing on our Dedicated pool at ~08:15 PT. Our engineers report high queue depth for all inference paths; p95 latency is >1.2s and p99 is not responding for several seconds. This is impacting our customer-facing flows (identifiers: checkout and fraud-check). Our contract has a 99.95% availability SLA and we're already seeing error rates that risk breaching that for the hour.

I've attached a quick screenshot of the p90 snapshot and an excerpt of our local audit log. Can Redwood confirm whether this is an internal capacity saturation or something on our side? We need an ETA on mitigation and request executive visibility if this will continue.

— Sara
Sara Mendoza
Head of Platform Engineering, ClearPoint Bank
attachments: p90_latency_snapshot_20261126.png, request_audit_log_excerpt.txt
From: Grace OConnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@clearpoint.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx + token queueing — urgent

Sara — thank you, and sorry for the disruption. We see the same signal in our telemetry: a sustained rise in queue depth in ClearPoint's reserved pool starting ~08:10 PT with a corresponding bump in 5xx rate from 0.02% to 1.8%.

Immediate actions (in flight):
- David is triggering an emergency slot reallocation in your reserved pool to shed noisy prefixes and reduce headroom contention. ETA 10–12m.
- We'll activate a temporary cold-fallback policy (route lower-priority requests to a compatible hosted variant) to protect latency-sensitive endpoints; this will be limited to non-auth flows unless you instruct otherwise.
- Olga is collecting kernel-level logs and KV cache health info; she requested the last 30 minutes of request ids (can you confirm you shared the audit excerpt?): request_audit_log_excerpt.txt looks useful.

Can you confirm the two endpoints most impacted (checkout and fraud-check) are the only customer-visible flows? Also let us know if you'd like us to elevate to execs now — we can pull in an on-call exec for visibility.

I'll update in 10 minutes with the reallocation result.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Grace OConnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx + token queueing — urgent

Quick triage update (internal):
- Confirmed noisy prefixes from two heavy batch jobs from a ClearPoint internal job (job ids included in the audit excerpt). Those jobs started at 08:05 and ramped without respecting the configured burst budget.
- Performed slot reallocation: shifted two compute slots and increased autoscale headroom for ClearPoint's reserved pool by 30%. Observed immediate drop in queue depth from 420 -> 80 and 5xx rate reducing to ~0.12% within 90s.
- Root vectors under investigation: KV cache eviction thrash and a kernel path regression in the 2.1.7 quantization runner under specific sequence length patterns. Olga is pulling a targeted trace so we can validate kernel fallbacks.

Next steps:
- Recommend temporary throttling of the two internal batch jobs (we can apply rate-limits via your job token) until we ship a kernel mitigation patch.
- Suggest a 2-hour bridge: we keep the cold-fallback policy ON for user-facing routes and run an ops window to hard-limit batch ingestion.
- If ClearPoint requests credits for SLA exposure, we will follow the escalation procurement path; need exec confirmation.

I'll attach the immediate metrics dump to the drive link (console link above). Olga, tag the kernel trace with the affected model/quant profile.

— David
David Kim
VP, Reliability Engineering, Redwood Inference
attachments: p90_latency_snapshot_20261126.png (internal copy)
From: Sara Mendoza <sara.mendoza@clearpoint.com>
To: Grace OConnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@clearpointbank.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Spike in 5xx + token queueing — urgent

Grace / David — thank you for the fast response and the reallocation. We're seeing error rates fall and latency recovering on the checkout flow. I escalated to our CTO and procurement; they're asking for an exec-level readout documenting: what caused the saturation, steps taken, timeline to permanent fix, and whether credits apply under our SLA.

Please loop in Redwood's commercial exec (we'd like a named contact) and provide a short incident summary we can share internally. We'll also pause the two batch jobs for the next 3 hours as requested — thanks for the clear guidance.

Sara
Sara Mendoza
Head of Platform Engineering, ClearPoint Bank
attachments: none
